rival_reading: The dates could describe routine access administration around the field route; neither a crossed line nor a missing crowd count shows officials caused the outbreak.
gloss: A road restriction is entered before its revision receives a signature.
title: Restriction recorded before revision signed
body: The map's road closure is dated before the revision is signed. A child's crayon marks the way home; the file's only completed count is copies returned, not people moved.

rival_reading: Public staff could record water allotments during a containment response and leave the source entry for a later review; the record does not establish an agricultural malfunction.
gloss: A field water tally predates a review date while its source remains blank.
title: Water tally predates review
body: The notebook lists water for two field rounds before the review date. A lunch reminder is taped to the bottle; the ledger counts delivered containers but leaves the source line blank.
